messages.content:
Relevant policy context:
- Damaged goods: Damaged-on-arrival items are refunded in full regardless of the 30-day refund window. No return shipment is required.
- Shipping times: Standard shipping is 5-7 business days. An order in the in_transit state has left the warehouse; processing means it has not shipped yet.

Customer question: The camp stove in order 8844 arrived damaged. What happens now?

request.system: You are a support agent for Northwind Outfitters. Use the tools to check facts before answering. Answer in at most two sentences.
